mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_account_selector_ticket ( ticket_hash, mobile_hash, candidate_digest, app_code, flow_type, status, expires_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{ticketHash}, #{mobileHash}, #{candidateDigest}, #{appCode}, #{flowType}, 'ACTIVE', #{expiresAt}, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_hash, mobile_hash, candidate_digest, app_code, flow_type, status, expires_at, consumed_time, version FROM public.auth_account_selector_ticket WHERE ticket_hash = #{ticketHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_account_selector_ticket SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
